x: Gerry Sexton is always there on a Monday night and I also hear that the other half of the 'Denmark Duo' Mick Sexton is in training for the Belgrave Open '7', that's the spirit.

Landlord of the "King of Denmark", Mick Sexton, a son of the Emerald Isle if ever there was, had his bid for the title brought to an abrupt end in the quarter finals when Bernard slipped an Irish Ceilidh Band record onto the juke box and poor Mick couldn't keep his feet still.
